description: Reference-panel registry for SNPshot local ancestry (Step 7). Each panel is a versioned, provenance-tracked descriptor consumed by ancestry.py / composition.py / watchlist.py. Population lists are NOT hardcoded in code; they are read from each panel's sample map. Sample maps and VCFs are gitignored (see .gitignore); only labels/counts are read.

panels.description: 1000 Genomes Phase 3 — the historical 26 fine-grain populations (baseline). Unchanged from the pre-Step-7 pipeline.

sources.name: 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3
sources.role: Reference populations + phased haplotypes (GRCh37 low-coverage call set).
sources.notes: 2504 unrelated samples; 26 populations across 5 super-populations. No Ashkenazi Jewish group.

notes: This is the panel the baseline chr22 run and all existing assets were produced with.
Super-population rollup is derived from the super_pop column of samples.panel.

panels.description: Expanded panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 3 (26 pops) PLUS a REAL Ashkenazi Jewish (AJ) reference group of 8 unrelated, modern, diploid individuals from the public Allen Ancient DNA Resource v66 Human Origins 'Jew_Ashkenazi' set. Adds one resolvable population the baseline cannot label.

sources.name: 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3
sources.notes: 2504 samples; disjoint sample ids from the AADR source (no duplicate individuals).

sources.name: Allen Ancient DNA Resource v66 / Human Origins (present-day)
sources.role: Real Ashkenazi Jewish reference individuals (AADR group 'Jew_Ashkenazi' -> AJ).
sources.citation: Mallick S, Micco A, Mah M, et al. Sci Data 11:182 (2024); PMID 37066305.
sources.notes: 8 unrelated (Family relations '..'), modern (Date BP 0), diploid '.HO' Affymetrix Human Origins individuals. Source .geno md5 verified (9f9f0629...); TGENO decoder cross-verified against DReichLab geno_single. 8054 chr22 biallelic SNPs; per-sample missingness 0.0-0.8%. Reconciled to 1000G REF/ALT (7646 shared; 408 unreconcilable sites dropped, never strand-flipped) and Beagle-phased against the 1000G panel (7616 phased sites).

notes: AJ rolls up to MID (Middle-Eastern / West-Eurasian), deliberately NOT merged into EUR, so AJ segments stay distinguishable from 1000G European sub-populations.
Array ascertainment: AADR Human Origins SNPs are a fixed, largely European-ascertained set. Only markers shared with the 1000G panel and the query are used for RFMix.
8 AJ individuals is a small reference group; chr22 AJ assignments are experimental and not a validated ancestry result. Accuracy is reported via the bounded held-out check.
The larger AJ WGS resource (The Ashkenazi Genome Consortium, EGA EGAC00001000151, 128 genomes) is access-controlled and NOT integrated here; see docs/step-07 for the application route.
